endorsements.name: Jarrod Farncomb
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-3708
endorsements.description: IsilonSD Management Server 1.1.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability while uploading an OVA file. A remote attacker can trick an admin user to potentially exploit this vulnerability to execute malicious HTML or JavaScript code in the context of the admin user.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.0, 8.3)
